text:
alex: Twilight handoff — jamal is primary, maria is secondary. quick recap below, pls ack.

oncall-bot: Pager: EMBED-503-EUW triggered 2026-03-16T18:12Z — elevated 503 rate for embeddings in eu-west. Pager level: P1. URL: https://incident.redwood/INC-8721

jamal: Ack. I'm on it. initial triage points to kvcache pressure -> eviction spikes -> embedding workers returning 503s.

jamal: Actions taken: scaled embeddings-deployment +2 replicas, cleared stale KV entries for region eu-west, bumped cache TTL for hot prefixes.

jamal: Commands run:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embeddings-eu-west --replicas=6
redis-cli -h kveuw01 FLUSHDB
```

maria: I'm the secondary and will watch routing fallbacks. if primary needs offload, i can take pages after 18:55 UTC.

nina: Support note: opened tickets for 3 affected enterprise tenants and sent an initial status at 18:28 UTC. no major customer errors reported, but elevated latency observed in dashboards.

alex: Timeline: 18:12 alert -> mitigation actions 18:18-18:24 -> error rate normalized ~18:36 -> monitoring until 19:00. impact window ~24 minutes.

jamal: Current status: embeddings 5xx count back to baseline; p95 token latency still slightly elevated (~150ms -> 210ms). investigating warmup effects.

sre-rotations: Note: there was a 10-minute coverage lacuna between 18:22-18:32 — rotation handoff mis-scheduled. adding an action to ops to patch rotation calendar.

alex: Runbooks referenced:
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-pressure
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503

jamal: Next steps (owners):
- jamal: follow up with infra to review Redis eviction metrics and eviction policy by EOD
- maria: validate routing fallback config and add synthetic checks for eu-west by tomorrow
- nina: follow-up customer comms with postmortem ETA at 12h

maria: I can take the 'validate routing' work. will post checklist in #eng-oncall-docs when done.

support-bot: Customer ticket updates:
- TENANT-42: initial note sent
- TENANT-88: monitoring only

alex: TL;DR for next shift: primary jamal -> continue monitoring p95 and eviction rate; secondary maria -> confirm routing fallbacks and synthetic checks; if repeat occurs escalate to eng-runtime.

jamal: ack. I'll leave a short snippet in the infra ticket with exact redis commands and metric graphs.

nina: I'll prepare the 12h postmortem draft and ping alex for review.

alex: Thanks team. handing off to nightshift shortly. :thumbsup:
